en.headline: Observatory forecasts mainly fine Saturday, cloudier Sunday for Hong Kong
en.dek: Saturday will be mainly fine and dry with highs around 29 degrees under an easterly airstream, while Sunday turns cloudier with a chance of light rain early.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory said an easterly airstream will reach the coast of Guangdong on Saturday morning, bringing mainly fine and dry conditions during the day with some cloudy periods at night.
Temperatures on Saturday are expected to range from 25 to 29 degrees Celsius, with moderate to fresh easterly winds of force 4 to 5. The probability of significant rain is low.

On Sunday, the weather will become mainly cloudy, with one or two rain patches possible at first and some bright periods during the day. Temperatures will range from 25 to 28 degrees, and relative humidity will be higher.

Looking further ahead, the northeast monsoon is expected to affect southern China early to midweek next week, making conditions windier with occasional light rain patches in the morning and at night. No weather warnings are currently in force.

zh.headline: 天文台預測周六大致天晴乾燥 周日雲量增多
zh.dek: 周六受偏東氣流影響大致天晴乾燥，最高約29度；周日轉為大致多雲，初時或有一兩陣雨。
body: 香港天文台表示，一股偏東氣流將於周六早上抵達廣東沿岸，日間大致天晴及乾燥，晚上部分時間多雲。
周六氣溫預計介乎25至29度，吹和緩至清勁東風，風力4至5級。顯著降雨概率低。
星期日天氣將轉為大致多雲，初時或有一兩陣雨，日間部分時間天色明朗。氣溫約25至28度，相對濕度較高。
展望下週初至中期，東北季候風將影響華南，該區風勢較大，早上及晚上或有一兩陣雨。目前沒有天氣警告生效。
